properties.name: Seattle
properties.access: Guarded roads, ferries, and controlled airspace
properties.description: Seattle survived because it remained useful enough to save. Its brilliant corporate core is surrounded by districts preserved through municipal inertia, neighborhood cohesion, local power, or luck.

properties.name: Everett Bastion
properties.known_for: Aerospace, heavy fabrication, and guarded port facilities
properties.description: Everett's aerospace factories, port infrastructure, and former naval presence gave it enough industrial capacity to remain viable and politically distinct from Seattle.

properties.name: Tacoma
properties.status: Metahuman-led military republic in an armed cessation with Seattle
properties.known_for: Deepwater shipping, military service citizenship, logistics, and political independence
properties.access: The Port of Tacoma, through traffic on I-5, and a porous defensive zone near Fife and Milton
properties.governance: The Tacoma Ephorate, or the Five, divides authority among ground defense, harbor and naval forces, intelligence, logistics and infrastructure, and civil defense
properties.communities: Citizens who earned status through military service, non-citizen residents, veterans, port workers, and metahuman families
properties.organizations: Tacoma Ephorate, Black Helix, Empty Seats, and the port authorities
properties.connections: International deepwater trade, Black Helix convoy security, and guarded commerce with Seattle along I-5
properties.description: Tacoma is a de facto independent metahuman state organized around military service and control of the region's primary deepwater port. Seattle refuses formal recognition, but commerce and mutual dependence sustain an armed cessation rather than a peace treaty.

properties.name: Silicon Wilds
properties.status: Eastside frontier of independent settlements, ruins, and salvage zones
properties.known_for: Kirkland Downs, Badvue, Forgetown, Fool's End, overgrown campuses, AI remnants, and salvage
properties.access: Lake Washington ferries through Meridian, I-405 and SR-520 corridors, or hazardous northern approaches
properties.governance: No regional government; settlement councils, house compacts, entrepreneurs, and fortified local rulers govern their own territory
properties.communities: Fishing and agricultural enclaves, casino workers, salvagers, frontier traders, manufacturers, and fortified settlers
properties.organizations: Soundline Co-op, Crosswake Marine, Lucky Crossing, Badvue's house compact, and Marshal Tamsin Rook's Fool's End
properties.connections: Meridian ferries feed the Eastside; I-405 links Kirkland Downs, Badvue, and Forgetown; SR-520 runs toward Fool's End; the frontier fades east into Cascadia
properties.description: Strictly east of Lake Washington, the Silicon Wilds are a patchwork of surviving enclaves, abandoned towers, server vaults, salvage zones, frontier communities, and half-functioning systems. Mercer Island is culturally and operationally tied to the Wilds, though it lies outside the geographic boundary. The eastern edge has no hard line and gradually becomes Cascadia.

properties.name: Cascade Approaches
properties.access: Expedition travel beyond the last checkpoints
properties.description: Corporate authority thins east of the surviving metropolitan corridor. Roads decay into defended routes between cohesive settlements, dangerous wilderness, and territories whose boundaries are not merely political.
